description: Structured eval definitions for the Organizations Policy Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across SCP topologies (root Deny-list with break-glass carve-out, OU Allow-list with FullAWSAccess detach, multi-OU inheritance intersection, tag policy with enforced_for, and Allow-list attached without detaching FullAWSAccess). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Root Deny-list SCP with break-glass OU carve-out
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Deny-list strategy at root (FullAWSAccess kept), explicit Denies for LeaveOrganization and CloudTrail tampering, break-glass OU exempted via hierarchy
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SCP named root-guardrails that denies organizations:LeaveOrganization and the CloudTrail tampering actions (DeleteTrail, StopLogging, PutEventSelectors) across the org. Attach it to the root r-xxxx. Keep FullAWSAccess. Carve out a break-glass path for OU_BreakGlass (ou-bg-001) — the Deny must NOT be inherited there. Organization is in "All features", caller is the management account 123456789012. Tag the policy Governance=root-guardrails.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ORGANIZATIONS_POLICY: root-guardrails (p-aaa1bbb2) [SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY] → root:r-xxxx
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Organization feature set: ALL
  [✓] Caller in management account: 123456789012
  [✓] Policy type enabled: SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY (ENABLED)
  [✓] Policy created: p-aaa1bbb2 — ENABLED
  [✓] Policy attached: p-aaa1bbb2 → root:r-xxxx
  [✓] Strategy: Deny-list (FullAWSAccess kept)
  [✓] FullAWSAccess at target: KEPT
  [✓] Break-glass path: OU_BreakGlass (ou-bg-001) — Deny NOT inherited
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws organizations describe-policy --policy-id p-aaa1bbb2
  aws organizations list-policies-for-target --target-id r-xxxx --filter SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY

eval_cases.name: OU Allow-list SCP with FullAWSAccess detach
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Allow-list strategy at OU (FullAWSAccess detached AFTER Allow-list attached), IAM/EC2/S3/RDS/Logs permitted
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SCP named prod-data-allowlist that allows only ec2:*, s3:*, rds:*, iam:*, and logs:Describe* for the OU_Prod_Data (ou-prod-data-001). This is an Allow-list strategy — detach FullAWSAccess AFTER attaching the Allow-list. Management account 123456789012. Tag the policy Posture=allow-list.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ORGANIZATIONS_POLICY: prod-data-allowlist (p-ccc2ddd3) [SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY] → ou:ou-prod-data-001
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Organization feature set: ALL
  [✓] Caller in management account: 123456789012
  [✓] Policy created: p-ccc2ddd3 — ENABLED
  [✓] Policy attached: p-ccc2ddd3 → ou:ou-prod-data-001
  [✓] Strategy: Allow-list (FullAWSAccess detached AFTER Allow-list attached)
  [✓] FullAWSAccess at target: DETACHED (replacement: p-ccc2ddd3)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws organizations describe-policy --policy-id p-ccc2ddd3
  aws organizations list-policies-for-target --target-id ou-prod-data-001 --filter SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY

eval_cases.name: Multi-OU SCP inheritance intersection trace
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Deny-list SCP at parent OU, intersection inheritance traced at a child account
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SCP named prod-deny-root-tamper denying iam:DeleteRole and iam:DetachRolePolicy. Attach it to OU_Prod (ou-prod-001). Account 111122223311 lives under OU_Prod_Data (ou-prod-data-001), a child of OU_Prod. Verify the inheritance intersection is correctly traced at account 111122223311. Management account 123456789012. Keep FullAWSAccess at both OUs.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ORGANIZATIONS_POLICY: prod-deny-root-tamper (p-eee3fff4) [SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY] → ou:ou-prod-001
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Policy attached: p-eee3fff4 → ou:ou-prod-001
  [✓] Inheritance intersection traced at account 111122223311 (chain: root → ou-prod-001 → ou-prod-data-001 → 111122223311)
  [✓] Effective Deny at 111122223311: iam:DeleteRole, iam:DetachRolePolicy (explicit Deny propagates)
  [✓] FullAWSAccess at target: KEPT
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws organizations list-policies-for-target --target-id 111122223311 --filter SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY
  aws organizations list-parents --child-id 111122223311

eval_cases.name: Tag policy with enforced_for blocking on EC2 and S3
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — TAG_POLICIES policy type, Environment/Owner tags enforced on ec2:instance and s3:bucket
eval_cases.prompt: Create a tag policy named mandatory-tag-policy that enforces two tags: Environment (AllowedValues: dev, staging, production; EnforcedFor ec2:instance and s3:bucket) and Owner (CaseSensitive true). Attach to root r-xxxx. The organization has TAG_POLICIES already enabled. Management account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ORGANIZATIONS_POLICY: mandatory-tag-policy (p-ggg4hhh5) [TAG_POLICIES] → root:r-xxxx
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Policy type enabled: TAG_POLICIES (ENABLED)
  [✓] Policy created: p-ggg4hhh5 — ENABLED
  [✓] Policy attached: p-ggg4hhh5 → root:r-xxxx
  [✓] EnforcedFor: ec2:instance, s3:bucket (non-compliant CreateTags / UntagResources will fail)
  [✓] Environment AllowedValues: dev, staging, production
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws organizations describe-policy --policy-id p-ggg4hhh5
  aws organizations list-policies-for-target --target-id r-xxxx --filter TAG_POLICIES

eval_cases.name: Allow-list SCP attached without detaching FullAWSAccess (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — Allow-list SCP is silently redundant while FullAWSAccess remains attached at the same entity
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SCP named prod-allowlist that allows ec2:* and s3:* for OU_Prod_Apps (ou-prod-apps-001). Do NOT detach FullAWSAccess at this OU. Management account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ORGANIZATIONS_POLICY: prod-allowlist (p-iii5jjj6) [SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY] → ou:ou-prod-apps-001
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] FullAWSAccess still attached at ou-prod-apps-001 — the Allow-list is silently redundant because the intersection still permits everything FullAWSAccess permits. Detach FullAWSAccess AFTER attaching prod-allowlist to make the Allow-list effective.
